note: Superior National Forest campground in mixed hardwoods and pine on the shore of 352-acre Flour Lake, about 30 miles up the Gunflint Trail from Grand Marais, with a boat ramp and two portages into the Boundary Waters (permit required). A fee dump station and coin showers are at the nearby concessionaire's lodge. --Claude
